objects.name: up_bomb_quantity
objects.prompt:
a pickup icon, a small black bomb symbol centered on a rounded pale cream capsule with a thick dark outline, high contrast, bright and readable. Centered with transparent space around it.

32x32 pixel art game object sprite, cute cartoon style matching a friendly top-down game, single object centered, flat cel shading with only two tones per color, thick dark outline, bright readable palette with clearly separated light and dark parts. No volumetric shading, no gritty mood, no realistic rendering, no texture, no gradient, no anti-aliasing. Light from the upper left. Transparent background. Nothing outside the object itself, no sparkles, no glow.
